title: +*INTRODUCTION TO NEW MEDIA COMMUNICATIONS
description: Approaches new media forms, such as virtual reality, games, social media, and artificial intelligence from a number of perspectives in communication research. Incudes new media topics of democracy, finance, intellectual property, and transmedia with an emphasis on the skillful management of change.
